adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, the first line is `embed_url = params.require(:embed_url)`, which will raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing` when the param is absent. The spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url" do; get :best; response.should_not be_success; end` neither asserts a 404 status nor any specific error handling, so its description (“is 404”) is unverified/misleading and would pass for many non-success outcomes (e.g., 400/403/500/redirect). Whether the exception propagates in this test harness can’t be proven from the diff alone, but the mismatch between the claimed 404 and the actual assertion is directly shown.
